summary: This section explains that the special rules for Producer Companies in this specific chapter are the most important ones. If any other law or company rule disagrees with these rules, the rules in this chapter win. However, other existing laws and rules still apply to the company as long as they do not conflict with this chapter.
points: The rules in this chapter override anything inconsistent in the Companies Act, 2013.
These rules also override any other current law that disagrees with them.
These rules override any other legal instrument or document created under other laws.
Other laws and instruments that do not conflict with this chapter still apply to the Producer Company.
example: Aarav Farmers Producer Company Limited wanted to register under the Companies Act, 2013. A question arose about whether an older cooperative law or the new special chapter rules should apply to their internal governance. According to Section 378ZQ, where the older law disagrees with the new chapter on Producer Companies, the rules in this new chapter must be followed. Meanwhile, other parts of the older law that do not conflict with the new chapter will continue to apply to Aarav Farmers Producer Company Limited without any changes.

terms.meaning: to have greater importance or authority than something else
disagreeing or not matching with something else
a legal document or written legal agreement

watch: Do not assume that all other laws are ignored; only the parts that conflict with this chapter are replaced.
